title: Labour
subtitle: Daily worker timesheets, approved and rolled into half-month pay periods
flow: Record the week → approve the timesheets → build the pay period (wage advances are deducted automatically) → approve the period → pay

grid.title: Timesheet
grid.hint: Click a day cell to cycle: full day → half day → empty. Enter OT hours under it, then save.
grid.empty: No entries yet. Add a worker or press "Fill from report" at the top of a day.
grid.fillHint: Fill workers from the crews in that day's site report

detail.title: Pay period
detail.notBuilt: This period has not been built yet. Press "Build period" to roll up the approved timesheets and deduct advances.
detail.approveBody: After approval the timesheets of this period can no longer be changed.
detail.unapproved: {count} timesheet entries in this period are not approved and are left out until they are.
detail.pendingApproval: This period is waiting for an approver.
detail.viaPayables: This period is paid through a payables run. Create a bill to pay it.

advances.title: Wage advances
advances.hint: Recovered from the next pay periods automatically, oldest first
advances.hidden: Your role cannot see wage data
advances.payNowHint: Choose a method if the money is already handed over; leave empty if not
advances.writeOffBody: The remaining amount will no longer be deducted from later periods.
